title: Stop an unchanged-source turn-end capture from voiding a fresh acceptance evaluation, and correct the misleading retry remedy
outcome: Stop an unchanged-source turn-end capture from voiding a fresh acceptance evaluation, and correct the misleading retry remedy
acceptance: The remedy Engram reports for an unconfirmed evaluated revision (today the EndTurnReadAndRetry text in src/work_service/source_recovery.rs, forwarded by the completion remedy) names a recovery action that actually clears the condition. Following it no longer recreates the same barrier; a behavioural test drives that recovery to a successful done.

A source_changed record after the evaluation cut whose measured source equals the judged revision no longer bars completion, while a source change to a different revision still bars. Behavioural tests cover both cases. If review concludes the equal-revision record must still bar, the item records that reasoning and the remedy says exactly what to do instead.
